axes: x right, y down on the plan crop (raster frame, 2.25 px/cm); origin = the crop's top-left; angles are bearings, 0 = up (-y), clockwise

plan_meta.source_file: apartments/apt846/_local/plan/plan-crop.png (a 288 dpi crop of the sales plan PDF 'דירה 846- 16.pdf', 1:50, DBLK 15.10.2025)
plan_meta.tracer: main session, trace-rooms.mjs (raster: grey fill = walls, double strokes = glazing, wall-connected single strokes = door leaves; zone bars from the config)
plan_meta.trace_method: flood fill from each camera inside a barrier mask built from the drawing; wall footprints from the grey fill (opened, 37 pieces); openings from region contacts and wall-end gaps; panes from double strokes split by adjacency
plan_meta.scale_basis: 2.25 px/cm from the 1:50 sheet at 288 dpi; checked against the printed 342×275 (bedroom) and 348×344 (main bedroom): traced 9.31 and 12.19 m² against printed 9.41 and 11.97
plan_meta.rights_note: the developer's sales plan held by Slava; a private pitch only until Israel Canada consents (D-WQ-18, OWED-658)
plan_meta.floor_height_note: floor 16 at about 3.2 m floor to floor (an assumption: the sales plan carries no section); the ground sits that far below the unit
assumptions: ceiling 290 cm (a plan drawing has no section; the 846 renders assumed 2.9 m)
door heads 215 cm, railing 110 cm, facade glazing floor to ceiling
the open-plan zone boundaries (kitchen | dining | living | hall, the terrace split, the wardrobe | bedroom) are virtual lines placed by hand

the guest bathroom and the main bathroom floors are the convex hulls of their traced regions
